mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, a.* FROM ( SELECT * FROM TOUR_DESTINATION WHERE CONTENT_TYPE_ID = #{contentTypeId} AND FIRST_IMAGE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CONTENT_ID ) a ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
SELECT count(*) FROM TOUR_DESTINATION WHERE CONTENT_TYPE_ID = #{contentId} AND FIRST_IMAGE IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM TOUR_DESTINATION WHERE LCLS_SYSTM3 = #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FIRST_IMAGE IS NOT NULL

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, a.* FROM ( SELECT * FROM TOUR_DESTINATION WHERE LCLS_SYSTM3 = #{category} AND FIRST_IMAGE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY LCLS_SYSTM3 ) a ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}

SELECT d.CONTENT_ID, d.CONTENT_TYPE_ID, d.TITLE, d.ADDR1, d.ZIPCODE, d.AREA_CODE, d.SIGUNGU_CODE, d.MAPX, d.MAPY, d.MLEVEL, d.FIRST_IMAGE, d.FIRST_IMAGE2, d.CPYRHT_DIV_CD, d.LDONG_REGN_CD, d.LDONG_SIGNGU_CD, d.LCLS_SYSTM1, d.LCLS_SYSTM2, d.LCLS_SYSTM3, d.CREATED_TIME, d.MODIFIED_TIME,
a.ACCOM_COUNT, a.CHK_BABY_CARRIAGE, a.CHK_CREDIT_CARD, a.EXP_GUIDE, a.INFO_CENTER, a.OPEN_DATE, a.PARKING, a.REST_DATE, a.USE_TIME,
w.PUBLIC_TRANSPORT, w.WHEELCHAIR, w.RESTROOM, w.ROOM, w.BRAILE_BLOCK
FROM TOUR_DESTINATION d LEFT JOIN TOUR_DETAIL_INTRO_ATTRACTION a ON d.CONTENT_ID = a.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN DETAIL_WITH_TOUR w ON d.CONTENT_ID = w.CONTENT_ID WHERE d.CONTENT_ID = #{id}
